slides.title: Knowing when an AI answer is wrong
slides.notes: Introduce yourself; the talk is about telling, from what the pipeline did, when its answer is wrong.

slides.title: An answer is worth more with its confidence
slides.notes: In a company the answer alone is not enough: the confidence says whether to act on it or have a person check it.

slides.title: The R2C2 task: answer, cite, and say how sure
slides.notes: R2C2 asks exactly this over a movie corpus of two million passages: for each of 64 questions, the passages that support it, at most 20, and an answer with a confidence from 0 to 100.

slides.title: One pipeline serves both subtasks
slides.notes: The model above chooses each tool call, one per turn; the orchestrator below checks every claim, keeps the record and rules on the answer. Every journey later in the talk is this ball's roll.

slides.title: Han Solo, pass 1: four turns, four tools
slides.notes: Pass 1 in full: one search, one read, one nugget the check scores 0.975, one submission. The gate accepts "Starkiller Base" at 98 on a single, very strong passage.
